close_reason: Fixed: upToId in EmailSubmission/queryChanges now returns invalidArguments for non-string values
description: submission.rs:213-216 uses v.as_str().map(Id::from) — maps non-string, non-null upToId to None without error. Email/queryChanges and Mailbox/queryChanges reject this with invalidArguments. Inconsistency: backend receives None upToId instead of an error, silently ignoring the client's intent.
title: EmailSubmission/queryChanges silently drops invalid upToId
